title: Figure 1.2: Idealized IEC potential structure (Hirsch), normalized ion density vs. radius
description: Black-and-white log-scale graph of normalized ion density (10^0 to 10^4) versus radius (0 to 1.0), with sharp peaks at vertical lines labeled "Virtual Anode," "Virtual Cathode" and "Real Cathode." Caption: "Figure 1.2. Idealized Potential Structure Calculated by Hirsch for Monoenergetic Ions With No Angular Momentum. The nested virtual anodes and cathodes observed were originally termed 'poissors' by the inventor, Philo Farnsworth."
